chunks: Divide the property into two parts
Then let the owner choose one. When he has chosen do not object to it.
Then divide the remaining into two parts
And let him choose one and when he has chosen do not raise any objection.
Continue like this till only that much remains which is enough to satisfy Allah’s dues.
Then take Allah’s due from it.
If he disputes your action allow his views,
and repeat what you had done before
till you take Allah’s due from his property.

key_terms.حَقِّ اللَّهِ: the right of Allah (referring to khums)

ai.seo_question: How is the khums tax calculated and collected according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This passage from Imam Ali’s instructions to tax collectors details a precise algorithmic method for extracting khums, ensuring the owner’s voluntary choice validates the deduction of the divine right. The iterative division and potential mixing of assets reflect a scholarly emphasis on procedural fairness and preventing arbitrary seizure, a principle deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence regarding wealth purification. It underscores the balance between state authority and individual property rights, where the collector’s role is to facilitate, not impose, the fulfillment of the religious obligation.
